gloss: amortization; writing off; paying off (a debt)

definitions.explanation: In accounting, spreading the cost of an asset over the years it is used, or removing its remaining value from the books. Most often met in the compound {減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}.
Clearing a debt or obligation by paying it back in full. More formal than {返済|へんさい} and largely limited to financial writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五年|ごねん}だ。
examples.english: The depreciation period for this machine is five years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得費|しゅとくひ}→取得費：30244_shutokuhi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧いく。
examples.english: The acquisition cost of the building is written off little by little each year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took ten years to pay off the debt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借入金|かりいれきん}→借入金：29454_kariirekin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{充|あ}てた→充てる：18707_ateru⟧。
examples.english: The company put part of its profits toward paying off its borrowings.

notes:
A financial term written with {償|しょう} (compensate) + {却|きゃく} (dispose of). Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{減価償却|げんかしょうきゃく}→減価償却：30207_genkashoukyaku⟧: depreciation of fixed assets
- {償却|しょうきゃく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: amortization period
- {償却|しょうきゃく}⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧: depreciable assets
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{償却|しょうきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pay off a debt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧: repayment — the everyday word for paying back money
- ⟦{焼却|しょうきゃく}→焼却：22409_shoukyaku⟧: incineration — a homophone with a completely different meaning; distinguish by context
